# AC Server Manager 0.4.1 Preview

Create a new local AssettoServer installation through a five-step wizard, without first building a server configuration in Content Manager.

## New in this preview

- Install the official stable Windows x64 AssettoServer release, a local ZIP or a local program folder. Existing configurations and private source data are not cloned.
- Select an installed track and layout, then choose cars, skins, quantities and player/traffic/mixed slot roles.
- Configure free-roam time, passwords, ports, WeatherFX and optional lobby registration before reviewing the result.
- Prepare a new server in a temporary folder, with cancellation and refusal to overwrite existing destinations.
- Include user, wizard and project guides in the portable package.

## Fix in 0.4.1

New servers explicitly set practice `IS_OPEN=1`. The earlier local 0.4 creation template omitted this setting, which could reject joining players with a handshake failure. Wizard integration checks now verify acceptance of an AC client handshake in addition to HTTP readiness and listeners.

## Download and run

Download **ACServerManager-0.4.1-preview-win-x64.zip**, extract the entire archive into a writable folder and run **AssettoServerManager.exe**. Windows x64; .NET is included. Keep the other files alongside the EXE. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the archive checksum.

Bring your own Assetto Corsa installation and mods. Content Manager is required for the manager's Connect action. AssettoServer is installed separately by the wizard; the game, CM and mods are not bundled. Existing local servers can still be edited and started.

## Preview scope

The wizard creates practice servers for local free roam. Presets, server cloning, automatic mod downloads, unpacked data packing, a complete AI/weather/plugin editor, port forwarding and external connectivity checks remain deferred. Traffic requires a suitable AI spline. Configuration changes require saving and restarting the server; Stop forcibly terminates the managed process.

Local validation includes core tests, wizard integration checks and successful in-game joining on Windows 11 x64. Handshake acceptance alone does not validate every later game/content check.

Application: MIT. Bundled .NET licenses and notices are included in `licenses/`.
